description: Macro economic news analyzer and forecaster for NAS100, S&P 500, and Dow Jones with Discord notifications

indices.name: Nasdaq 100
indices.driver: Highly sensitive to US 10Y Yields, Big Tech valuation, growth multiples, AI capex, and discount rate expectations

indices.name: S&P 500
indices.driver: Broad macroeconomic barometer, balancing tech growth with financial, healthcare, and consumer stability

indices.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
indices.driver: Value, cyclical industrials, retail banks, and infrastructure; sensitive to GDP growth and industrial PMI

intermarket.name: US Dollar Index
intermarket.correlation: Inverse to Equities (Strong Dollar = Tight financial conditions & headwind for multinationals)

intermarket.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
intermarket.correlation: Key discount rate benchmark (Spiking yield directly compresses Nasdaq P/E multiples)
